BiblicalUsage: The handful is the priest's measure: he shall take his handful of the flour and the oil with all the frankincense, and burn the memorial of it upon the altar, and the same handful is taken of the sin offering and of the offering of jealousy.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the handful is the part that stands for the whole, and God accepts the part as the whole when it is offered in faith.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
